TanStack Router errorComponent (JavaScri.description:
Render a route's error state; reset clears the boundary so the loader runs again. Pass it as the route's errorComponent option.

渲染路由的错误状态，reset 清除边界后 loader 会重新执行；作为路由的 errorComponent 选项传入。

TanStack Router errorComponent (TypeScri.description:
Render a typed route error state; reset clears the boundary so the loader runs again. Requires the ErrorComponentProps type from @tanstack/react-router.

渲染类型化的路由错误状态，reset 清除边界后 loader 会重新执行；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 ErrorComponentProps 类型。

TanStack Router pendingComponent.description:
Show a loading state once a navigation has been pending for pendingMs, holding it at least pendingMinMs so it does not flash. Insert as route options inside createFileRoute.

导航等待超过 pendingMs 后展示加载状态，并至少保持 pendingMinMs 以避免闪烁；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router notFoundComponent.description:
Render this route's not-found state. Insert as a route option inside createFileRoute.

渲染该路由的 not-found 状态；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router notFound.description:
Signal a missing resource from a loader; the nearest notFoundComponent renders. Pass routeId: rootRouteId to show the application-wide one instead. Requires notFound from @tanstack/react-router.

在 loader 中表示资源不存在，由最近的 notFoundComponent 渲染；传 routeId: rootRouteId 则改由全局的那个渲染；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 notFound。

TanStack Router route boundary options.description:
Attach the error, pending and not-found components of one route. Insert as route options inside createFileRoute.

为单个路由挂上错误、等待与 not-found 组件；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。
